name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: AI-Native Lifecycle Marketer | Agentic Automation, Personalization & Monitoring
summary: Agentic operator and lifecycle marketing systems builder who writes the copy, builds the automation, and reads the results personally - no agency, no hand-off. Founder of Solenzo, where I architect AI-driven lifecycle systems that score engagement signals and trigger personalized email, SMS-style, and in-app-style sequences across the full customer journey: capture, qualification, booking and confirmation, no-show recovery, onboarding nurture, and long-term reactivation. I build the monitoring that catches a broken message before a customer does, and I've been translating loosely-formed business intent into precise automation logic since before it was called agentic AI.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architect and deploy autonomous, AI-driven marketing systems end to end - largely on GoHighLevel - automating lead enrichment, personalized outreach, and appointment booking without manual intervention.

Architected a complete lifecycle-automation system - 20+ workflows spanning lead capture/tagging/routing, qualification, appointment booking with confirmation and reminders, no-show recovery, post-sale onboarding nurture, long-term nurture/reactivation, and automated review-generation sequences.

Break down manual marketing workflows into agent architectures with custom logic that scores a business's digital footprint and generates hyper-personalized outreach - personalization at a grain a human couldn't produce by hand.
Design self-improving monitoring loops and evaluation frameworks that catch broken or underperforming automation logic and continuously optimize conversion rates.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' generalized ideas and feedback into precise, structured AI prompts and agent instructions, then rapidly prototype and deploy the resulting automation myself.
Draft the direct-response copy, outreach sequences, and landing pages myself, then track results in GA4 and CRM analytics and use the data to keep iterating.
Built an automated prospect 'audit' workflow that enrolled 180+ contacts, scoring each business's digital footprint to trigger individually personalized outreach.
